dos.text: Pass an explicit mode such as this.FIND_NORMAL when calling open(), called bare it only sets findMode "if (mode != undefined)" and otherwise silently keeps whatever mode was left over from the previous session.

donts.text: Don't expect setting the browserid attribute alone, or reading the browser getter, to register the finder, connectedCallback only wires up finder.addResultListener and setFindbarInActor as a side effect of actually assigning to the browser property.

Don't call toggleHighlight(true) again expecting a re-highlight after page content changes, the method short-circuits with "if (highlight === this._highlightAll) return" before ever calling finder.highlight(), so toggling to the same value twice in a row does nothing.
